Derek goes to pick up a veteran 1904 Swift, there's an emotional farewell to a 1980s Bedford HA van, and a Toyota Corona finds a new home.
Teleshopping.
Teleshopping.
Drew asks Michael and Maria to revamp a ventriloquist doll that's over 100 years old. Lighting expert Jolene is tasked with reviving a dusty chandelier.
Drew discovers a classic manor house in Oxfordshire has a quirky interior. And he meets the next generation of antiques dealers near Newcastle.
Drew visits an antiques shop in Edinburgh and a cycle museum. Exploring a 750-year-old house, he finds an item that takes him out of his comfort zone.
Scorching 45-degree desert heat pushes Rick to his limit. Alex risks facing snakes in his hunt for gold-rich pay dirt, and Greg crosses Australia to care for his sick father.
The Dirt Dogs and Gold Gypsies fight back against the rising number of gold thieves. Meanwhile, the Scrappers' washplant conveyor belt comes to a screaming halt.
Bushmen Rod and Les risk their lives reopening a long-abandoned mine. New team the Young Guns go deep underground for the first time, hunting pineapple opal.
Rookie team the Young Guns have a life-threatening moment hunting legendary pineapple opal. The Cooke Bros scramble to hunt on another miner's claim for a share of the find.
In Sheffield, Drew finds a stunning collection of antique cutler's stools. Later, he heads to Leeds where he finds some rare streetlights at a heritage railway and museum.
The duo explore Shane's epic collection, where a stylish Lanchester LD10 catches their eye - a perfect fit for their love of post-war British cars.
The pursuit of profit sees Henry and Fuzz rummaging through Rebecca and Sue's sheds near Newark. It's home to all manner of vehicles and parts.
In Bournemouth, Henry and Fuzz look through Max's vast automobilia collection. Whilst some are fully restored, others need fixing up. What will they come away with.

programmes.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
programmes.d: The boys head to Birmingham, where they look through a demolition expert's trove of salvage. Simon finds a dilapidated chaise longue and then the boys argue about an old bench.
Angus finds quirky mementoes in TV presenter Helen Skelton's beautiful home and explores comedy legend Nick Hancock's barn conversion.
The team clear out the home of a retired couple who own an impressive collection of Ladderax furniture. Later, Angus sees potential in some commemorative coins.
Auctioneer James Braxton and Izzie Balmer hit Shropshire in the Morris Minor for the third leg. From bamboo buys to beautiful boating, it's a hoot.
Action Stations! A battalion of Action Man toys, an old RAF jacket, and a Second World War sweetheart brooch end up in a bidding war as they go under Angus's gavel.
Irita cuts through a clearance of vintage gear in a Kent barbershop, but the discovery of a 300-year-old Chinese vase excites the sale room.
Deep in the countryside, expert restorers take in Britain's broken and battered artefacts and bring them back to life while learning the rich history of the objects.
How do they turn trees into pencils? How do they make liquorice? And, how do they use traditional techniques to weave the world's most fashionable lace.
How do they mine one of the world's most valuable metals, platinum? How do they produce manga comics? How do they turn lemons into an Italian after-dinner drinks.
How does one family in America make three quarters of the world's peppermint oil? Plus, how are performance-enhancing tennis racquets made.
How do they make a trombone? How do they make traditional Spanish wineskins? Plus, how do they turn smelly muddy peat into rejuvenating face cream.
Drew takes Viki to his favourite hunting grounds. Together, they pick through a dusty old shed, a quality auction, and a beautiful country house.
Drew and Al pick through the collection of a travelling fairground family. Then, they are invited to a traditional wood-turning business.
In rural Devon the boys fall for the Gallic charm of a Renault 4. It's a rare limited-edition model - can Drew and Paul replicate its unique interior fabric.
Find out how to tan fur, create photographs, make welding electrodes and produce electric violins, as more items are put under the microscope.
Find out how glass bottles, hacksaws and goalie masks are made, as more everyday items are put under the microscope.
Teleshopping.
Teleshopping.
Sculptor Nick works on a fairground centrepiece. French polisher Alex transforms a mill trolley, and upholsterer Craig revamps a battered armchair.
At a recently closed department store, Drew faces a potential shopping spree. At a Warrington fairground business, he unearths 100-year-old puppets.
Drew goes on his first ever buying trip to Northern Ireland. He visits Belfast's biggest salvage yard and falls for a vintage Japanese beauty.
The Mahoneys spend thousands of dollars on a loader for a final push at 8-Mile, and Alex is convinced there's big gold at Relief Creek. The Gold Gypsies strike it lucky.
With the season close to ending, the Dirt Dogs struggle to hunt out their final $350,000 of gold. The Mahoneys bring in machinery in a final effort to hit their target.
The Tunnel Rats blast their way to a fortune and solo prospector Col Duff is stranded deep in the Queensland outback. Rookie Sam runs out of air underground.
Old partners Aaron Grotjahn and Col Duff reunite on a prospecting mission. Meanwhile, the Tunnel Rats race to protect their claim as rival miners close in.
Drew is in Cheshire to scour a barn packed with items, from traditional antique furniture to taxidermy. And in Sheffield, he uncovers a collection of early 20th century glass eyes.
Henry and Fuzz visit Stuart in Wales and uncover a Morris 35 van. It's tired but full of charm. Can they get its wheels turning again.
In Derbyshire, Henry and Fuzz visit Rob's haven of classic and rare bikes. They explore his collection of 1960s Lambretta scooters and 1920s 'flat tankers'.
In Lincolnshire, Henry and Fuzz trawl through Dave's eclectic mix of military, classic and agricultural items. What will they come away with.

programmes.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
programmes.d: Henry and Simon head to Burton-on-Trent where they search through a petrol head's collection. Henry gets excited about a dump trump and a remote-controlled plane.
Angus helps Eurovision icon Cheryl Baker sell some pop memorabilia. Later he helps comedy legend Syd Little raise funds for his new pet project.
Angus is excited to clear out a historic property in Long Itchington. Each room is full of interesting items, including vintage furniture and precious jewellery.
In Somerset and Dorset, James nabs a handsome portrait and diamond ring while Izzie is locked behind bars in the oldest prison in the world.
Henry and Fuzz meet a lifelong biker with unique motorbikes. Fuzz discovers a 1950s step through scooter, but Henry prefers low-capacity sports bikes.
Henry and stand-in searcher Guy are in Wiltshire visiting collectors Adam and Dan who have an assortment of trucks, tractors, and rare American cars.
The Misfits have hired a demolitions expert, the Bushmen are stuck in an underground death trap, and a storm is brewing for the Blacklighters.
Master saddler Susie has a fight on her hands with a pair of tired boxing gloves. Metalworker Dom works on a toy bike gifted by Laurel and Hardy.
How do they make the perfect surfboard for catching waves? Plus, how do they turn Danish cream into one of the world's favourite butters.
How are million-dollar racehorses transported across the world to their new owners? Plus, what creative methods are used to photograph food.
How do they produce a million tonnes of stainless steel? How do they keep cash safe with an uncrackable lock? How do they make traditional Indian sugar.
How do they harvest three thousand tonnes a year of the world's weirdest seafood delicacy? Plus, how do they protect water polo players from injury.
Drew and Viki deal with a haggling Blacksmith in Yorkshire. Then, they visit a 19th-century country mansion on the south coast of Scotland.
In Yorkshire, Drew and Al pick through a stash of antiques belonging to a highly regarded dealer. Then, they visit a fourth-generation metalsmith.
Salvage aficionado Drew Pritchard visits Britain's oldest number plate maker. And, Paul and Drew disagree about adding a mega engine onto a tiny Italian classic.
Find out how lacrosse sticks, frozen fish products, torches and paintbrushes are made, as everyday items are put under the microscope.
Find out how deep cycle batteries, optical lenses and tins are produced, as more everyday items are put under the microscope.
Teleshopping.
Teleshopping.
French polisher Alex is challenged to rescue a settle bed. James restores a Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine, while Ted works on two weathered chairs.
Drew visits a magnificent manor in Devon, home to the same family for 600 years. And he finds quirky collectibles at an antiques shop in Bournemouth.
Drew does battle at a castle in Essex in a quest for architectural antiques. Plus, he drives a hard bargain on automobile memorabilia in Lancashire.
The Baggage Battlers are back. Today they visit an auction in Brooklyn, one of the busiest shipping ports in the USA, but will they unearth any treasures.
The Baggage Battlers head to Atlanta, Georgia, to a freight auction where Mark spies some Rolls Royce aircraft parts, but will his bid secure the items.
Chris McCully and crew hit a paystreak so lucrative they call it 'Wall Street.' Shawn strikes gold at 40 feet under the ice. Vernon's diver faces a disaster.
Jane clashes with Emily's crew over being disrespected. Equipment failures cause delays for Chris and Shawn. Kris is thrilled to find his Crawler in action.
The Gold Devils set their sights on a record-breaking total. Plus, a gold drought causes one member of the Poseidon Crew to question his future.
After years of apprenticing for natural builders, Sonia Havill is putting her skills to the test by building an off-grid cob cottage on top of an Oregon mountain.
Two natural builders team up to experiment with a never-before used building material: mushrooms. They hope to virtually grow a home that blends into the environment.
Keith must retrieve a lost anchor in 50-knot winds. Sig attempts a risky new fishing strategy. Rick faces losing a greenhorn to a gruesome injury.
New discoveries might finally explain the truth behind one of the Triangle's most infamous mysteries, when 306 US Navy crewmen vanished without a trace.
Josh treks the Inca Trail through the Andes and into the Peruvian Amazon in search of a mythical city of gold. His journey takes a detour to the ruins of Machu Picchu.
Josh dives into the Lajas Reef in search of the treasure of legendary pirate Henry Morgan. His journey takes him to a modern marvel, the Panama Canal.
A Big Island family finds their off-grid paradise strangled by destructive storms that bring deadly pests and invasive guava trees.
The Opal Whisperers' partnership with veteran miner Uwe ends abruptly. The Misfits finally hit old timers' workings at the bottom of their open cut mine.
The broke Bushmen are forced to trade opal to get a shaft drilled on a new claim. The Digi Diggers get lost exploring a terrifying abandoned mine.
Rick's start to the season only gets worse when he finds his truck's been ransacked. Plus, the Dirt Dogs ambush a gold thief and their chances of a profit takes a hit.
The Gold Gypsies get to work to reach their ambitious target. Plus, desperate to get back on track, Rick takes a gamble and heads to an old mining town. But will it pay off.
A widowed homesteader, realising she didn't learn the skills she needed before her husband's passing, is overwhelmed by her large family homestead.
Jess and Phil's investigation into unidentified objects off Catalina Island's coast heats up after the discovery of an extra-terrestrial underwater base.
Dropped onto an Alaskan glacier, all-star survivalists Laura and Steven stave off frostbite and hypothermia. Their skills and survivor instinct are tested.
In the Honduran rainforest, a survivalist and a hard-headed detective try to thrive for 21 days. But, jaguars, fire ants and a debilitating injury may stop them.

The Baggage Battlers head to the Boston Estates Auction to gamble on historical items, but is a document announcing George Washington's death the real thing.
The Baggage Battlers head to Greensboro, which is a major hub for imported and exported goods. But will they unearth any valuable items in the lot at Quality Salvage.
The Kellys try to make their gold-sucking Crawler work. Vernon's plans falter as he deals with health issues. Jane receives news of the birth of Emily's baby.
The Kellys try to make their gold-sucking Crawler work. Vernon's plans falter as he deals with health issues. Jane receives news of the birth of Emily's baby.
The Gold Devils move their multi-million-dollar operation in search of big gold. And, new team Vince, Bibi and Murray break ground on their dream lease.
A 29-year-old woman builds a 2,000-square-foot dream home with three bedrooms and three bathrooms out of mud and completely off the grid in Arizona.
Self-taught homebuilder Jacob Hamby constructs miniature cabins all over the US, surviving on the land while building his clients new homes.
Sig gets blown off course in extreme seas. Jake faces the loss of his longtime engineer. Monte takes the wheel of the Wizard when Keith collapses.
In 1945, five US Navy planes vanished without a trace in the Bermuda Triangle. Experts investigate why the planes disappeared and where they could be today.
Josh scours the Virginia backcountry in search of the legendary Thomas Beale treasure. With encrypted codes hiding its whereabouts, can he solve the mysterious puzzle.
Josh Gates travels to the UK and Norway to unlock the secrets of a mystical crystal used by the Vikings. Before testing it, he explores a crypt in a Nordic church.
Novice farmsteaders in Iowa are on the verge of losing the legacy of their late father. The Raneys must quickly give them an off-grid masterclass.
Lisa jeopardizes a sale with a bespoke jeweller designer. Rod goes toe to toe with ratters who stole opal and equipment from their mine.
A vicious storm threatens to end the Misfits season early. Plus, Issy attempts a new black-lighting technique to impress Opal Joe.
The Scrappers are robbed, threatening their chances of turning a profit. Meanwhile, the Millzilla unexpectedly breaks down, costing the Dirt Dogs $1,000 a day.
One of the gold hunters unearths a monster nugget that dramatically transforms their season. Plus, the Gold Gypsies are hit by the worst storm in decades.
Josh Gates recounts members' death-defying exploits! Two submariners plunge seven miles under the Pacific and a pilot skydives from the edge of space.
Ed Stafford challenges endurance athlete Matt Graham to a rematch in Scotland's cold and brutal highlands. They must endure freezing conditions to make it to Ben Nevis.
Josh wants to investigate ghostly sightings and terrifying sounds coming from an abandoned canal along the Potomac. What will they uncover.
For Better Or A Lot Worse. The first couple to ever take on the challenge test their survival skills and relationship. They face jaguars, anacondas and caiman in the Guyana jungle.
Two superfans battle oppressive heat and relentless insect attacks in Guyana's scorching savanna. Severe dehydration forces a desperate fan to drink unsanitary fluids.

The Baggage Battlers head to London, home to six airports, where Billy, Mark and the Martins compete for the lost and unclaimed bags of the rich passengers.
The Baggage Battlers wage war at the crazy, eclectic Santa Cruz Lost Property Auction, where Mark brings in reinforcements to battle Billy over antique toys.
Mr Gold and Chris McCully battle it out for the top spot on the gold board. The Kellys are at risk of ending the season with no gold.

The Ferals are on the gold when a four-wheeler crash leaves them man down. Plus, the Poseidon Crew battle to overcome a catastrophic mechanical failure.
